standard_prerequisites.name: The reduction of the cohomological dimension to the local case, and the characterisation of cohomological dimension by the vanishing of the cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on the complement
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 769 and 781) as pointers to items of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduce the second assertion to a local ring and translate the required vanishing into a statement about the complement.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the spectrum of a quotient as the support of the corresponding module, and the identification of the local cohomology of a module over the quotient with the local cohomology of the ideal extended to it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 789-794) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduce the first assertion to the second applied to the quotient by the annihilator.

core_obligations: Reduce to a local ring: the second assertion is reduced to the case of a local ring, where either the closed subset is empty, in which case there is nothing to prove, or the complement misses the closed point and therefore has strictly smaller dimension (proof lines 767-772)

Use the structure of the complement: the complement of the closed subset is a quasi-compact open of the spectral space, hence itself spectral, so the vanishing theorem for the cohomological dimension of a spectral space applies and gives the vanishing above the dimension of the ring, which is the second assertion (proof lines 773-784)

Reduce the first assertion to the second: passing to the quotient of the ring by the annihilator of the finite module, whose spectrum is the support, and noting that the local cohomology of the module does not change when the ideal is extended, the bound for the quotient ring gives the vanishing above the dimension of the support (proof lines 786-796)
Conclusion: the first assertion follows, and the 'in particular' is the second assertion for the structure sheaf (proof lines 795-796)
proof_roadmap: 先证第二句：由 lemma-cd-local 化归 A 局部；V(I) = ∅ 平凡，否则补集 U 不含闭点故 dim U < dim A，且 U 是谱空间的准紧开集从而是谱空间，由跨章的谱空间上同调维数消没定理得 H^i(U,F) = 0 (i ≥ dim A)，再用 lemma-cd 得 cd(A,I) ≤ dim(A)。
再证第一句：令 a 为 M 的零化理想、B = A/a（Spec(B) = Supp M），J = IB，则 H^i_{V(I)}(M) = H^i_{V(J)}(M)（跨章引理），对 B 用第二句即得 i > dim Supp(M) 时消没。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the local cohomology of a finite module by the dimension of its support and the cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal by the dimension of the ring (author lemma at source lines 758-764, label lemma-cd-dimension). The proof (source lines 766-797) first reduces the second assertion to a local ring, where the complement of the closed subset is a quasi-compact open of the spectrum and hence a spectral space missing the closed point, so that the general vanishing theorem for spectral spaces applies (proof lines 767-784); the first assertion is then deduced by passing to the quotient by the annihilator of the module and using the invariance of the local cohomology under that passage (proof lines 786-796). The reduction of the first assertion to the second through the quotient by the annihilator is the content. H2.
